title: Book One · Chapter 87: What Dad Promised
story:
Dad is mending a strap. Ronan sits near him and asks about the old shop.

Ronan wanted to ask this question after the returned handle. Now Dad is looking for a short piece of thread. Ronan asks his question as they sit together.

“Did jobs come back there too?”

Dad stops searching. He sits down on the stool.

“Yes.”

“How many?”

“Some. One group of jobs was especially bad for us.”

Mum is sorting cloth beside the window. She hears them, but does not answer for him.

Ronan sits on the floor. He can see the toolbox under the table. The blue paint has a worn patch beside the handle.

“Could you not fix them?”

“I could do some of the work. I said yes to more than I could finish well.”

“Like a very big pile?”

“Yes. I gave people times for the work. I did not check those times first.”

Dad puts the strap across his knee.

“Then I hurried. Some work was wrong. People paid for the work and waited for it. I had to put jobs right and pay money back.”

Ronan thinks of Mr Sun moving the cards. “Did someone else make you hurry?”

“I felt pressure to work fast. People were waiting. But I made those promises myself.”

“Were the people bad?”

“They paid for the work. They wanted the right work back. They were angry, but they were not bad people.”

The room is quiet except for Mum's scissors. She cuts one long strip, puts them down and looks at Dad.

“We stopped taking new jobs. Some costs still continued,” she says. “Your dad can tell you more when you are older.”

“Was it because of my bicycle?”

Dad bends forward at once.

“No. Your bicycle did not cause it.”

“But you sold it.”

“We needed money after the mistakes. Your mum and I decided to sell it. We needed to speak to you first. We did not do that.”

Ronan looks at the shelf. The bell catches a little light from the window. Dad said that last part before. Now he tells Ronan about the mistakes before the sale.

He wants Dad to be the best person with tools. Someone else could make a wrong promise. Ronan does not want that person to be Dad.

“Are you good at your work?” he asks.

Dad takes a long breath.

“I can do good work. I can say, ‘I am good.’ But words do not fix things. I need to check my work.”

Mum reaches for the strap. “And find the thread you put beside my elbow.”

Dad looks. It is there, in plain sight.

“My helper found it.”

“Your helper wants the table clear before bed.”

Ronan laughs at Mum's little joke. He feels less worried as he sits with Dad. He holds the strap while Dad draws the thread through. They can do this safe work together. Dad keeps the needle in his own hands.

Afterwards, Ronan asks one more question.

“Will you have your own shop again?”

“I am not planning that now. I want to do the work in front of me.”

Ronan does not like every part of the answer. He rests his head against Dad's knee anyway. Dad leaves one hand on Ronan's hair. Mum folds the last strip of cloth beside them.
studyGuide:
## 重点表达

- promises＝承诺
- pressure＝压力
- pay money back＝把钱退还
- in plain sight＝就在眼前

额外情节词（不要求本章全部记住）：strap＝带子；scissors＝剪刀；needle＝针。

## 读句提示

**I did not check those times first.**

我／事先没有核对／那些时间。使用did not，不用had not checked。

## 理解问题

1. Dad承认旧店出了哪些由自己造成的问题？
2. Ronan仍然希望父亲是什么样的人？
